verdict.rationale: Productboard is a SaaS platform with a REST API and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents only production-workspace access, with no sandbox workspace, test environment, dry-run mode, or isolated test data. The quickstart describes authenticating and seeing "real data come back," and the MCP server connects to the live workspace.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
